capabilities: Generate color palettes with a scheme picker and reroll
Show color chips beside hex codes in notes
Render palette blocks as clickable swatch strips
Extract color palettes from images embedded in notes
Pick a screen color with an eyedropper and insert its hex
extras: Part of a larger Palette Vault project with a companion website and Chrome extension; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate, preview, or extract color palettes while writing notes.
summary: Color palette plugin that generates schemes, shows hex code chips inline, renders palette blocks, extracts colors from images, and includes a screen eyedropper.
